title: fix(picks): one shared start / exit pick mechanism for every kind
body:
## What changed

- New `docs/decisions/1448-start-exit-shared.md`. It records each answer of #3324: the choice, the reason and the dropped options. The issue names this path, so the file uses it in place of `3324-<slug>.md`.
- New shared type `camcraft_motion::path_picks`: `PathPicks { start, exit }` of `PathPick { xy, z }`, and `PickRole`. The type holds lists. `PathPicks::refusal` refuses a second pick of one role by name. It also refuses a coordinate that is not finite or is more than 1 km from the origin.
- New `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`:
  - `PickCapability` (`Ring`, `Region`, `HoleOrder`, `Ends`, `Raster`, `Threading`, `NotTaken(reason)`).
  - `KindInfo::pick()`, an exhaustive match on `OpType`. 2D Contour is `Ring`. Wire Contour is `Threading`. Probe is `NotTaken` ("cuts no path"). Every other kind is `NotTaken(PICK_OWED)` until its family slice of #1448 ships.
  - `OpParams::path_picks()`, one accessor for every kind. It reads `links.approach.start_point` / `exit_point` and `WireContourOp.start`.
  - `OpParams::pick_refusal()`. `named_refusal` now calls it in place of the old hard-coded match.
- MCP: the `params` description of `edit_operation` names `links.approach.start_point` and `links.approach.exit_point` and the kinds that take them. Each kind of `list_operation_types` has a `start_exit` answer (`start`, `exit`, and `field` or `why_not`).
- UI: every operation page draws the Start point and Exit point groups. A kind that does not take a pick shows one line in each group: "Not taken - <reason>". The line is on the Lead in / Lead out tab, or on Geometry when the kind has no lead tab. The contour keeps its editable rows.

## Cause

The maintainer could not see a start or exit point on the 2D Offset (#1448, 2026-11-22). Only the closed 2D Contour took a pick. The refusal on other kinds did not name the kind. No page said that the pick is not taken. The family slices of #1448 had no shared mechanism.

## Message change

The refusal of a pick on a kind that does not take it was:
`a start point is taken only by the 2D contour so far - clear it on this operation`.
It is now, for example:
`2D Offset: a start point is not taken - the planner chooses the entry and the exit of this kind until its slice of #1448 ships; clear it on this operation`.
The tilted contour refusal does not change.

## Original implementation tests (historical)

These results predate the review fixes. The final head results are in the section below.

Pins:
- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs` (new, 4 tests):
  - `a_pick_on_a_kind_that_does_not_take_it_names_the_kind_and_the_reason`
  - `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick`
  - `path_picks_reads_the_contour_pick_and_the_wire_start`
  - `the_mcp_doors_name_the_pick_fields_and_the_kinds_that_take_them`
- `egui_app::start_exit_rows::tests::kinds_without_a_picked_start_say_so_by_name`. It was `kinds_without_a_picked_start_draw_neither_group`. The expected behaviour changed on purpose. It now also covers the 2D Offset.

Red before the fix: the two MCP tests ran on unchanged code and failed. The refusal said "taken only by the 2D contour so far" with no kind name. The schema said only "Fields to change". The other two tests use the new API.

Mutations:
- `sane.rs` from `upstream/main`: `a_pick_on_a_kind_that_does_not_take_it_names_the_kind_and_the_reason` is red. Restored: green.
- The `not_taken_groups` call in `op_page.rs` removed: `kinds_without_a_picked_start_say_so_by_name` is red. Restored: green.

Unchanged and green: `contour_start_point` (8 tests, with the golden `contour_start_point.cl`), and the start / exit UI tests (`start_exit_rows`, `start_exit_pick`, `start_exit_viewport`).

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` ran 347 steps, and 346 passed. The one red step was `machine::a_kind_that_is_not_a_kind_refuses_at_the_door`. Upstream fixed that test in 80e8891e0 after the branch point (the router kind of #3279). After a merge of `upstream/main`, these pass: `machine` (33), `start_exit_shared` (4), `contour_start_point` (8) and the UI `start_exit` tests (13).
Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

## Review fixes

Final source head: `f32d552dcc92ac58dc9c5b4a346b9aa68396dfe7`.

- Finding 1: The screenshot pairs below show the Lead in / Lead out and Geometry placements. All six image URLs return HTTP 200 and match the captured PNG bytes.
- Finding 2: Wire Contour draws its existing Start hole controls inside the shared Start point group. The Exit point group still gives the reason that it is not taken.
- Structural pin: `egui_app::start_exit_rows::tests::the_wire_geometry_tab_groups_the_start_hole_and_says_the_exit_is_not_taken`.
  The test checks both groups and the Start hole controls. It checks that only the exit is not taken.
  Folding Start point hides its controls, preserves the start coordinates, and leaves Exit point visible.
- Mutation: Restoring `start_exit_rows.rs` and `wire_page.rs` to the reviewed head makes the new test RED: `Wire Contour has Start point on Geometry`.
  Restoring the fix makes all seven `start_exit_rows` tests GREEN.

## Final head verification

All commands use source head `f32d552dcc92ac58dc9c5b4a346b9aa68396dfe7` and base `upstream/main`.

- Initial quick gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` ran 348 steps. 334 passed. Fourteen UI steps failed to compile with E0463 for missing crate artifacts.
- The retry removed only debug artifacts for workspace crates and disabled sccache. It ran `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --failed gate-logs/quick-20261122-122803`.
- Retry: 14 steps ran. Thirteen passed. The UI library ran 1,425 passing tests, one failing test, and seven ignored tests.
- The remaining failure is `egui_app::post_dialog_tests::desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably` at `post_dialog_tests.rs:69`. The latest review reproduced this failure on upstream main.
- Combined quick result: 347 of 348 steps passed. The one remaining red step has the known baseline failure above. All graphics tests passed with software Vulkan.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed in 65.7 seconds.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: GREEN. All 241 reached steps passed in 44.0 minutes (2,637.85 seconds).
- Heavy results: 35 motion targets passed 59 tests. Two hundred one app targets passed 46 tests.
- Four checks for known failures failed as expected for open issues #1950 and #2849. The gate accepted these checks.
- All 14 start/exit UI tests passed. The new structural pin and its mutation evidence are recorded above.
